stages.title: fixed-m3 complete-cost CDCL(T)/Fp screen
stages.population_rule: natural rows alone estimate e; planted and exact-unsat are separately reported controls
stages.advance: complete verified natural panel and all controls; reconciled ledgers; frozen power; upper intervals e < 0.5 and a < 1.5 outside A/A spread
stages.not_advance: on the same complete valid powered panel, a lower interval has e >= 0.5 or a >= 1.5
stages.otherwise: inconclusive, including any natural timeout, OOM, unknown, unproved UNSAT, missing rung or failed control
